policyRequirement: Product / Functional Owner가 변경등급과 계약의미를 확정한다. Backend/UI/Platform은 구현 중 발견한 문제와 대안을 제안할 수 있으나 업무 Contract를 직접 변경하지 않는다.
reason: A linked mutable Issue/Action legitimately advances during correction but the completion package retains an exact earlier reference and exposes no authorized way to refresh it. Preserve exact version guards and history while restoring legal workflow reachability.

optionalPayload.mark_ready_for_handover: punchIssueRefs + correctionActionRefs (paired; exact original Punch identity set and complete current verified/closed Action cycle)
optionalPayload.refresh_issue_references: currentIssueRefs (exact original Issue identity set; open or explicitly closed/verified only)
optionalPayload.refresh_remedy_references: issueRef + actionRefs (same defect Issue identity and exact linked Actions in its current correction cycle; assigned/in-progress Actions are allowed before remedy start, while remedy acceptance still requires verified/closed Actions)
